title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Arizona
description: Ten currently documented food destinations with late availability in Tucson, centered on campus and nearby corridors.

cards.title: Turkish Kebab House
cards.subtitle: 810 E University Blvd · open daily until 2 AM
cards.notes: Use the Main Gate Square address for a seated or takeout meal; check the official hours before heading over, especially on holidays.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard Turkish and Mediterranean restaurant with daily late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s official site lists its 810 E University Blvd address and business hours of 8:30 AM–2 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists daily business hours of 8:30 AM–2 AM.

cards.title: Arabic Express
cards.subtitle: 806 E University Blvd · takeout listed until 1 AM
cards.notes: Order pickup or delivery from the University Boulevard location when you need a food option after typical dinner hours; confirm timing in advance.
cards.short_summary: A Middle Eastern restaurant at the campus-side end of University Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Arabic Express’s official ordering site identifies 806 E University Boulevard and lists takeout hours until 1 AM on listed days.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists takeout through 1 AM on Monday–Friday and Sunday; Saturday is listed through midnight.

cards.title: Geronimo Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 806 E University Blvd · takeout listed until 1 AM
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering page to check pickup hours and place an order; the location sits directly on the University Boulevard corridor.
cards.short_summary: A late-listed breakfast and American-food pickup option near the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Geronimo Restaurant’s official ordering page lists 806 E University Blvd and takeout operation until 1 AM on listed days.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists takeout until 1 AM Monday–Friday and Sunday, and until midnight Saturday.

cards.title: Fuku Sushi
cards.subtitle: 940 E University Blvd · open until 2 AM Tue–Sat
cards.notes: Check the posted daily schedule before going; the restaurant lists midnight hours on Sunday and Monday and later hours Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A sushi restaurant on University Boulevard with late posted closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Fuku Sushi’s official site lists 940 E University Blvd and hours until 2 AM Tuesday–Saturday, with midnight closing Sunday and Monday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11 AM–2 AM Tuesday–Saturday and 11 AM–midnight Sunday and Monday.

cards.entity_name: Shark's Grill at U of A South Rec
cards.title: Shark's Grill at U of A South Rec
cards.subtitle: U of A South Rec · 7–11 PM Mon–Fri
cards.notes: Find the truck at U of A South Rec on weekday evenings and use its official location page to verify service before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A campus food-truck stop with documented weekday evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: Shark’s Grill’s official site lists its U of A South Rec location as open 7–11 PM Monday through Friday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists U of A South Rec service Monday–Friday, 7 PM–11 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 1055 N Park Ave
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Park Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1055 N Park Ave · lobby listed until 4 AM daily
cards.notes: Use the Park Avenue location if you need a walk-in option after late evening; verify the location page for any holiday or temporary changes.
cards.short_summary: A Park Avenue fast-food location with 4 AM lobby hours listed every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official location page lists lobby hours at 1055 N Park Ave as open until 4 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1055 N Park Ave
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists lobby hours from 4 AM to 4 AM daily, indicating continuous daily availability.

cards.title: Wendy's on North Campbell
cards.subtitle: 1005 N Campbell Ave · open until 1 AM Thu–Sat
cards.notes: Choose restaurant or drive-thru service at this campus-area address; check the official schedule because closing shifts between midnight and 1 AM.
cards.short_summary: A North Campbell fast-food restaurant with midnight-or-later posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 1 AM Thursday–Saturday and until midnight on other days.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 1 AM Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Del Taco on East Broadway
cards.subtitle: 840 E Broadway Blvd · open until midnight most days
cards.notes: Use this Broadway location for a late pickup, delivery, or dine-in stop; the official page shows a slightly earlier Sunday close.
cards.short_summary: A downtown-adjacent taco location with midnight hours on six days each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco’s official location page lists the 840 E Broadway Blvd store open until midnight Monday–Saturday and until 11 PM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists store and delivery hours until midnight Monday–Saturday; Sunday until 11 PM.

cards.title: Taco Plus Mexican Grub
cards.subtitle: 4352 E Speedway Blvd · open 24 hours Tue–Sun
cards.notes: This is farther east on Speedway, so plan transportation; use the official page’s posted schedule and order link before going late.
cards.short_summary: A Speedway Boulevard Mexican fast-food stop with six days of 24-hour service listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Plus Mexican Grub’s official site lists 24-hour service Tuesday–Sunday and Monday service until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Tuesday–Sunday as open 24 hours and Monday as 7 AM–midnight.

cards.title: El Potosino Mexican Food
cards.subtitle: 1400 W Prince Rd · open 24 hours daily
cards.notes: Plan a ride to the Prince Road location and confirm availability before leaving; the restaurant’s own menu page identifies it as a 24-hour operation.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Mexican-food restaurant for an all-night Tucson option beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: El Potosino’s official menu page states that its 1400 W Prince Rd location is open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Monday–Sunday hours as 24 hours.
